root_cause.text: The dpaa2-switch IRQ handler accesses the `ethsw->ports` array using an unvalidated `if_id` value extracted from the hardware status register, allowing out-of-bounds memory access when `if_id` exceeds `sw_attr.num_ifs`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the handler uses `if_id` to index `ethsw->ports[]` "without validation" despite `if_id` potentially being any 16-bit value larger than the allocated array size, and the patch fixes this by adding the bounds check `if (if_id >= ethsw->sw_attr.num_ifs)` before the array access.
